window: Past 24 hours, with search-index lag: the one new item is an Ecuadorian operation announced on 10 November. Searches across US federal, local US and military counter-narcotics sources surfaced nothing new and verifiable; recent strike and seizure results were either already logged or dated 2025.

stories.headline: Ecuador's Gran Fénix 070 raids hit a Posorja port cocaine network, 11 held and 1.36 tonnes tallied
stories.summary: Ecuadorian police announced on 10 November the results of a roughly three-month probe, executing 11 raids in Guayaquil, southern Quito and Sucre canton in Manabí.
